story_overview: In a series of tense encounters, a group finds themselves in conflict. After a menacing introduction from Viktor, characters like Marco and Tess are seen hiding, while struggles erupt in corridors and a construction zone, involving Rico, Axel, and Nate. A bloody tank top passes between characters, hinting at a preceding violent event.
